title: Improving fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.20020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This thesis investigates the expressive power of neural networks for structured data, focusing on graph neural networks and symmetry-aware architectures.   We present four main contributions. First, we characterize the generic expressive power of geometric message-passing neural networks on sparse graphs and introduce EGenNet, an architecture achieving the corresponding guarantees. Second, we use representation theory to characterize linear layers equivariant to multiple permutations, including wreath-product symmetries. Third, we study permutation-invariant set representations that preserve containment, establish dimensional bounds and impossibility results, and introduce MASNet. Finally, we propose FSW-GNN, a message-passing architecture combining strong expressivity and bi-Lipschitz stability guarantees with strong empirical performance on long-range graph-learning tasks. translated_title: 提升图神经网络的细粒度表达能力
translated_abstract: 本论文研究了面向结构化数据的神经网络表达能力，重点关注图神经网络与对称性感知架构。我们提出了四项主要贡献。首先，我们刻画了几何消息传递神经网络在稀疏图上的一般表达能力，并提出了实现相应保证的EGenNet架构。其次，我们利用表示理论刻画了对多种置换（包括圈积对称性）等变的线性层。第三，我们研究了保持包含关系的置换不变集合表示，建立了维度界和不可能性结果，并提出了MASNet。最后，我们提出了FSW-GNN，这是一种兼具强表达能力、双Lipschitz稳定性保证的消息传递架构，并在长程图学习任务上展现出优异的实证表现。这些结果共同为图神经网络表达能力提供了更广泛的理解。
tldr: 本论文通过刻画几何消息传递网络在稀疏图上的表达能力、利用表示理论分析多重置换等变线性层、研究保持包含关系的置换不变集合表示，并依次提出EGenNet、MASNet和FSW-GNN三种新架构，系统性地提升了图神经网络的细粒度表达能力与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This thesis systematically improves the fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks by characterizing geometric message-passing networks on sparse graphs, equivariant linear layers via representation theory, and containment-preserving set representations, introducing three novel architectures: EGenNet, MASNet, and FSW-GNN.
